name: Table I v2 (ScanNet): read-out-only predictives selected on validation
status: registered before any ScanNet run (validation or test); scripts/scannet_tab1.sh refuses to make a v2 selection while this file has uncommitted changes, and its test stage refuses when the file differs from the one the selection was made with
rules_from: configs/tab1_v2_prereg.json (Table I v2 on Replica, wip/t4a-predict 29fadfb, registered 2026-10-10): grids, metric, tie, choices and ablations copied unchanged, scenes replaced by the ScanNet scene files (the copy its scripts/replica_tab1_v2.sh prescribes for another dataset); tests/test_scannet_loader.py checks that the copied entries equal that file's
maps: the ScanNet maps and fields of scripts/scannet_tab1.sh (one 3DGS fit and one semantic field per scan, shared by the v1 and the v2 rows): every v2 row is a read-out of the saved field statistics
pipeline: scripts/scannet_tab1.sh: STAGE=val (fit one temperature per row on the validation scans, evaluate them with --v2-rows, write the selection), then STAGE=test once
test_look: FIRST look at the ScanNet test split: no ScanNet scan was mapped or evaluated before this file was registered

metric.name: nll
metric.text: validation NLL in nats with the coverage rule (variant 'all'), pooled over the labelled pixels of all validation scenes: sum_s n_s NLL_s / sum_s n_s, n_s = labelled pixels of scene s; temperatures fit by eval_seg.py on the same validation scenes (one per row, as in v1)

tie.rule: candidates within tol nats of the lowest value tie; the tie goes to the one listed first; lists run from the reference setting outward (P1: c0 = 1, the FieldConfig default; P4: lambda = 1, the vMF moment match, then alpha0 = 1, the flat Dirichlet of CSS's default; @ours_v2: the v1 predictive ours_P2 first, so a v2 row must beat it by more than tol)

reporting: Every candidate (ours_P2, ours_P2p1, the P1 c0 grid, the P4 grid) and the ablation ours_P4_inf is evaluated on the ScanNet validation and test scans and reported, selected or not; test numbers of rows not selected are labelled 'not selected'.
@ours_v2 is the open-vocabulary predictive of the ScanNet Table I v2; if it is ours_P2, the table keeps P2 and the v2 rows are reported as not better on validation.
The selection is final once STAGE=test starts: test numbers never change a choice, a grid, a tie rule or this file.

The ScanNet numbers are 2D per-pixel scores on held-out frames of the mapped trajectories; they are not comparable with the 3D point-level mIoU that OpenGaussian and NormLift report on the same scans and classes.
